newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar finishes with fresh losses.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar finishes with fresh losses.

text.p: More liquidation hit LIFFE white sugar futures late on Tuesday, but prices finished off their lows on trade buying, dealers said.
"The charts look terrible so it may have been some funds," one trader said.
Most-active December touched a low of $321.50 per tonne, but finished at $322.50, still $2.10 weaker. March slid to $318.30, but closed at $319.00, a loss of $2.80.
Volume was 2,674 lots with the bulk in December at 1,085 lots.
Most of the earlier activity had been centred on commission house crosses and forward spreads.
In Paris, December finished down $3.20 at $322.50 and March also $3.20 lower to $320.00.
